### scikit-learn 1.9.1 CI follow-up

The first latest-scikit-learn run exposed a mismatch in the new test oracle: the production call passed an all-ones `sample_weight` array, while the independent reference fit omitted it. scikit-learn 1.9.1 uses a different forest bootstrap path when sample weights are supplied, so those are not interchangeable random draws. Commit `e4bfd36113426a9459b66d976ee76dd776d557b9` passes identical fit parameters to both fits; the production patch and assertion tolerances are unchanged.

The corrected tests were replayed with both frozen scikit-learn 1.8.0 and 1.9.1: each exact-base run has 13 regression failures, and each patched run has 38 focused passes/2 skips plus 759 full-suite passes/3 skips. Complete repository isort/Black, changed-file Flake8, build, and strict Twine checks also pass in both environments.
